scenario.label: Monsoon break — cooler, near-normal stress
scenario.summary: Pre-monsoon squall line brings cloud, breeze and rain showers. Tmax stays 6–8 °C BELOW the 1991–2020 normal: thermal stress is Normal in most zones and Watch in the densest core. No heatwave candidate fires.
scenario.tagline: What NORMAL and WATCH conditions look like.
teaching_points: Normal/Watch levels exist so operators can see the quiet state too
Cloud and wind cut the globe temperature — radiation matters, not just Tmax
A below-normal day can still carry modest WBGT in full sun
